article.title: 博報堂推Shopify商品資料方案，把規格連到使用情境
article.summary: 博報堂與Hakuhodo DY ONE推出Data Enrichment on Shopify，為既有商品資料加入顧客用途和使用情境。
highlights: 擴充資料可在Shopify商品主檔、描述和自訂欄位管理。
外部AI內直接完成購買仍取決於當地支援。
article.why: 電商團隊可核對用途描述是否有原始規格支持，再評估推薦和結帳路徑。
article.next_step: 挑一款商品，逐項列出規格、用途及不適用情況，再核對資料欄位和商品頁。
article.detail: 博報堂描述的方案會把商品規格與顧客想解決的問題建立關聯，再把資料寫入Shopify商品主檔、描述及自訂欄位。公告把外部AI內即時查庫存及完成交易視為隨支援擴展的情境。品牌試做時可先檢查每句用途描述的依據，再逐步驗收推薦、商品頁和結帳連結。各欄位亦可指定資料更新人員。
article.title_en: Hakuhodo adds usage context to Shopify product data
article.summary_en: Hakuhodo and Hakuhodo DY ONE announced Data Enrichment on Shopify to add shopper needs and usage context to existing product data.
highlights_en: Teams can manage enriched information in Shopify product records, descriptions and custom fields.
Completing a purchase inside external AI depends on local support.
article.why_en: Commerce teams can check whether use cases are grounded in product specifications before assessing discovery and checkout.
article.next_step_en: Select one product and verify specifications, use cases, exceptions and fields against its product page.
article.detail_en: Hakuhodo says its solution links product specifications to shopper needs and writes information into Shopify product records, descriptions and custom fields. Real-time inventory checks and purchases inside external AI depend on expanded support. Review the basis for each use case before checking recommendations, product pages and checkout links. Assign an owner to update each field.
